problem_set.name: coding-template-with-git-sample
problem_set.description: Git-enabled coding template - sample JSON serialization bug task

problems.system_prompt: You are a software engineer debugging a codebase. You have access to bash and file editing tools. The repository has full git history available — use git log, git blame, git diff, etc. to investigate issues. Fix the code and verify your fix works.
problems.task_prompt:
You will be working on a task for project.
The repository has already been cloned in /home/ubuntu/project.
You have full git access — use git log, git blame, git diff, etc. to investigate.

Use the tools provided to complete the following task:

Fix the JSON serialization bug in server.py.

The API server's responses are malformed. When you make a request to any endpoint,
the response body is not valid JSON - it looks like a Python dict representation
instead of proper JSON (e.g., single quotes instead of double quotes).

Hint: use git log and git blame to investigate when the bug was introduced.
